item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 1:33 AM, 13 September 2026(Sunday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad and Norzagaray), Quezon (Panukulan, Burdeos, and Infanta), and Rizal (Rodriguez and Tanay) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Quezon (General Nakar) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 10:00 PM, 12 September 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over Greater Metro Manila Area(Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna and Cavite) within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.
